# Colgrid

> Colgrid is a real-world team game that turns a city into missions. Teams meet in one walkable neighborhood for a 2–4 hour gathering and take on quests hosted by local makers, kitchens and guides. Players earn XP, levels and badges on a web pass that carries forward to every gathering and every city. Colgrid is based in Salt Lake City, Utah.

## Key facts

- What it is: a persistent real-world team game (not a one-off outing). Your team, level and badges carry forward.
- Where: Salt Lake City, Utah. Each gathering is in one walkable neighborhood; the starting location is revealed 24–48 hours before.
- Format: teams of players, 2–4 hours, 3–4 hosted quests, local tastings, and a shared finale meal. The app guides each team from mission to mission; teams prove each stop by being there and answering something only visible on site.
- Who it's for: adults 18+ who want more from a night out than dinner and drinks: friends, partners, family, coworkers and solo players. Solo players are placed on a team.
- Competitive? No. Nobody is ranked; it's about the experience. Everyone earns XP, levels and badges.
- Price: $75 per player, sold on Eventbrite.
- A ticket includes: 3–4 hosted missions, local tastings, the finale meal, a keepsake, and your Colgrid pass.
- Next gathering: the first Colgrid gathering is Saturday, October 17, 2026, 4–7 PM, in 9th & 9th, Salt Lake City. $75 per person, adults 18+. Tickets: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/9th-9th-interactive-team-quest-tastings-finale-meal-tickets-2002520543853
- Companies: private team runs from $2,500 for up to 20 players (+$95 per extra player). Request a quote: https://getcolgrid.com/companies
- Local businesses: makers, kitchens and guides can apply to host a quest: https://getcolgrid.com/hosts
- Contact: https://getcolgrid.com/contact
